Short title extent and commencement

THE FINANCE ACT, 1957
THE FINANCE ACT,
1957
ACT No. I of 1957
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., dated
the 11th February, 1957, Ext., p. 286.)
[4th March,
1957]
An Act to give effect to the financial proposals of the
Central Government for the year beginning on the first day of April, 1957.
WHEREAS it is expedient to fix
the duty on certain salt, to fix maximum rates of postage under the Post Office
Act, 1898, to continue subject to certain modifications, for a further period
of one year additional duties of customs imposed by section 6 of the Finance
Act, 1942, and to alter the duty of excise on motor spirit, to continue the
charge and levy of business profits tax, to make certain provisions relating to
income‑tax, super‑tax, excess profits tax, business profits tax,
sales tax, betting tax, urban immovable property tax and excise duty, to fix
rates of income‑tax and super tax and to continue, subject to
modifications, the taxes and duties imposed for the purpose of meeting
expenditure on the rehabilita tion of displaced persons ;
It is hereby enacted as follows :‑
1. Short title and extent-----‑(1)
This Act may be called the Finance Act, 1957.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.

Continuance of duty on salt

salt--------The duty on salt manufactured in, or imported by land into,
